restaurants.name: Fesslhütte

attractions.name: Dürnstein
attractions.description: Medieval Danube village, 'the pearl of the Wachau', with a single main street, the Krems Gate, blue-façade Baroque Stiftskirche, Town Hall courtyard, and Burgruine castle ruin where Richard the Lionheart was held captive in 1192 (about 20 min uphill walk; Lionheart themed trail).
tips: Try Wachauer Laberl rolls from Schmidl bakery and local apricots
attractions._source_file: Switzerland/All Inclusive Guide - Switzerland and Austria(1).docx

attractions.name: Domäne Wachau
attractions.description: Wine tasting of Wachau signature wines such as Grüner Veltliner and Riesling

attractions.name: Dürnstein Village
attractions.description: 'Pearl of the Wachau' with medieval lanes, boutique wine shops, hidden courtyards, riverside paths and pastel buildings; compact and best explored on foot from the Krems Gate
tips: Parking near the Krems Gate area is ideal
Historic center is 2–5 minutes' walk from parking

attractions.name: Dürnstein Abbey Stiftskirche Tower
attractions.description: Iconic blue-and-white Baroque tower; one of the most photographed landmarks in the Wachau

attractions.name: Schloss Dürnstein
attractions.description: New castle dramatically positioned above the Danube, now a luxury heritage hotel

attractions.name: Burgruine Dürnstein
attractions.description: Castle ruins where Richard the Lionheart was imprisoned in 1192; panoramic views over Dürnstein, the Danube and vineyards
tips: Attempt only with good energy, pleasant weather and comfortable shoes

attractions.name: Vineyard Walk to Unterloiben
attractions.description: Walk through vineyards via a vineyard trail past the French memorial or a Danube riverside path; Oberloiben and Unterloiben are the heart of Wachau wine country

attractions.name: DDSG Blue Danube Wachau Cruise
attractions.description: Scenic cruise through Wachau vineyards and riverside villages from the dock near the Dürnstein river promenade
tips: Reconfirm cruise timings a few days before travel, as schedules vary seasonally

local_dishes.name: Wachauer Laberl
local_dishes.description: Local bread rolls, home of which is the Schmidl bakery in Dürnstein.
